name: Pholus
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 5145 Pholus (1992 AD): diameter 190 km; JPL's stated reference: Earth, Moon, and Planets, v. 89, Issue 1, p. 117-134 (2002)
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 190 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Pholus. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed colour or terrain.
introduction: Pholus is a centaur, a small icy body orbiting the Sun among the giant planets.
card: A centaur orbiting among the giant planets.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 190 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
